inspection.method: Actual bounded primary-document web passage inspection
inspection.scope: Actual selected functional passages, printed pp.8–14 and 19; pull-up equations and graph, printed p.50.
inspection.limits: No blanket inspection of High-speed or Ultra Fast-mode, all timing tables, or target-specific register protocols. title: The RS-485 Design Guide
reason: Physical topology, termination, signal and idle-state reasoning for the actual two-link bench.

inspection.scope: Actual primary application note selected sections, pp.1–4. Communications contribution independently inspected printed pp.1–5, topology, signal levels, cable, termination/stubs, failsafe, loading and rate/length tradeoff.
inspection.limits: Engineering guidance rather than the complete TIA normative standard. Example bias values are not copied across supply voltages or transceiver types; use the declared part datasheet. RS-485 is an electrical specification, not an addressing, framing or bus-access protocol. Unit loads are not a universal device-count limit; maximum rate and length cannot be combined independently.
